data.long_meaning: In ancient Greek culture, the name Xenos referred to a foreigner or a traveler. The root of the word comes from the Greek word 'xenos' which means 'guest' or 'stranger'. Xenos was also used in the New Testament to describe a Samaritan who helped a Jewish man in need.
